subject: Meditech VPC: sustained p95 latency & intermittent 5xx — request for exec sync
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@meditech.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, ops+platform@meditech.com
Cc: CloudOps Solutions <support@cloudopssolutions.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in p95 and 5xx from our VPC (prod, since 03:00 PT)

Hi Priyom / Redwood team,

We're seeing a sustained increase in p95 latency (up from ~220ms to 1.4s) and intermittent 500s for our production VPC since ~03:00 PT. The error rate is small in % but it's affecting a high-volume route and causing downstream timeouts in our API layer.

What we've already tried:
- Restarted a subset of the inference nodes (no change)
- Increased replica count temporarily (reduced p50 but p95 remains high)

Attached are the logs and a small KPI snapshot. We need an urgent assessment and, if necessary, an exec-level sync to decide on mitigations (temporary routing to hosted, broad credits for affected customers, etc.). Our CTO is available for a 30-min slot today afternoon PT.

Trace sample: trace-id=mt-prod-7f3a2b (included in logs).

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director, Platform Engineering
Meditech

[Attachment: svc_logs_20270728.tar.gz (compressed logs)]
[Attachment: p95_kpi_snapshot_20270728.csv]

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@meditech.com>, ops+platform@meditech.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 and 5xx from our VPC (prod, since 03:00 PT)

Thanks Elena — and sorry you're seeing this. We consider this high priority. Quick plan:

1) Immediate triage (I will lead) — can you confirm whether the affected model route is the standard /generate-text endpoint or a custom model bundle?
2) Aditya, can you pull the node-level telemetry (GPU utilization, kernel queue depth, inflight batch sizes, GC events) for the last 6 hours and compare to baseline?
3) We'll propose a 30-min exec sync today at 15:30 PT — pls confirm availability, Elena.

Temporary mitigations we can enable immediately if you want:
- Route ~20% of traffic to the hosted fallback (same model family) for burst smoothing
- Lower max_batch_size and enable aggressive batching timeouts to reduce latency tail (trade-off cost)

I've attached the logs Elena uploaded to our shared drive and added the Atlassian ticket (OPS-1298).

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Linked artifacts uploaded to: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/meditech-metrics-20270728]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@meditech.com>, CloudOps Solutions <support@cloudopssolutions.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 and 5xx from our VPC (prod, since 03:00 PT)

Quick findings from the first-pass log + metric sweep:

- GPU utilization looks normal (~50–65%) on majority of nodes, but one node (node-7) shows sustained kernel queue length spikes and periodic NVENC stall indicators around the trace-id provided.
- KV-cache warmup is delayed for new sessions (high cold-start ratio over the last 2 hours) — likely due to a surge of un-cached prefixes after a customer migration at 02:40 PT.
- We see occasional 502/504s from the local proxy when an outlier batch takes >3s to decode and the proxy times out.

Short actionable recommendations (no-regret):
- Spin a replacement for node-7 and drain it ASAP (we can do live drain).
- Temporarily reduce max_batch_size from 32 -> 16 and set max_batch_wait_ms=10 to prioritize latency tails.
- Enable prefix caching for the heavy route (we have a warmup rollout artifact we can push) — this should drop decode p95 quickly.
- As a fallback, enable routing policy to divert 15–25% traffic to our hosted tier for the affected model.

I'll prepare a short ops playbook (commands, endpoints, expected metric deltas) and share it in the ticket within 30m.

— Aditya
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: playbook_troubleshoot_node_drain.txt (commands + expected outputs)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@meditech.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 and 5xx from our VPC (prod, since 03:00 PT)

Looping in for exec alignment — Marcus/Laura, please be prepared to join a 15:30 PT sync with Meditech and their CTO. Goals for the call:

- Present immediate mitigations + timeline (node replacement, batch-size change, routing to hosted)
- Confirm rollback criteria and SLO impact; draft customer communications and credit proposal
- Agree who owns follow-up tuning (runtime kernel-level work vs. config changes) and ETA for medium-term fix (kv-cache tuning + warmup automation)

Elena — we can offer a one-week service credit pro-rated for affected routes as mitigation while we stabilize. We'll finalize amount on the call.

If the node replacement + cache warmup don't bring p95 under 600ms within 45–60m, we'll trigger the routing fallback.

— Stephanie
VP, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@meditech.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: ops+platform@meditech.com, CloudOps Solutions <support@cloudopssolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 and 5xx from our VPC (prod, since 03:00 PT)

Thanks, team — the 15:30 PT sync worked well and your runbook was helpful. Summary for the thread:

- Node-7 replacement completed; prefix caching rollout applied to the heavy route; p95 dropped from ~1.4s to ~420ms across traffic that saw cache hits.
- We accepted routing of 20% traffic to hosted for 3 hours while we verified warmup behavior on other nodes.
- We will provide a follow-up trace file (trace-id mt-prod-7f3a2b-extended) and a sample of slow requests this weekend for deeper kernel-level analysis.

Next asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short post-mortem (one-pager) outlining root cause, timeline, and long-term mitigations (KV warmup automation + better node health detection)?
- We'll confirm credit details next week after calculating revenue impact.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elena
Director, Platform Engineering | Meditech

[Attachment: followup_traces_mt-prod-7f3a2b-extended.log]
